what: State payment in lieu of taxes to Providence for exempt private colleges and nonprofit hospitals (RIGL 45-13-5.1), reimbursed at up to 27% of the tax the property would have paid.
reported_base_note: Property tax that Providence reported the qualifying institutions would have paid, on assessments as of Dec 31, 2023 (column A of the FY2026 calculation).

sources.title: House Fiscal Advisory Staff, Local Aid, 2025 edition, Appendix VII
